context: Hiroshi-boss gives Yuki instructions across departments.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business ops; vocabulary (部門/本部/指示/工事/資格) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 各部門に、指示を出してくれ。
lines.style: composed boss voice, soft warm authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 本部からの指示、ということですね。
lines.style: reliable office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ああ、本部の方針として伝えてくれ。
lines.en: Yes, convey it as headquarters' policy.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 工事の部門にも、伝えますか?
lines.en: Do I tell the construction department too?
lines.style: attentive office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 工事は、資格を持つ者に任せよう。
lines.en: Leave construction to those with qualifications.
lines.style: firm boss voice, soft warm authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 資格者の一覧を、本部に送ります。
lines.en: I'll send a list of qualified people to HQ.
lines.style: professional office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 各部門の連携を、しっかり頼む。
lines.style: composed boss voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 指示どおり、進めてまいります。
lines.style: resolved office woman voice, soft warm clarity closing throughout
